$driverId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['driverId','latitude','longitude','vehicleType','vehicleModel','vehiclePlate','driverName','rating','isAvailable','timestamp']) && newData.child('driverId').val() == $driverId && newData.child('isAvailable').isBoolean() && newData.child('timestamp').isNumber() && newData.child('rating').isNumber() && newData.child('rating').val() >= 0 && newData.child('rating').val() <= 5 && newData.child('latitude').isNumber() && newData.child('latitude').val() >= -90 && newData.child('latitude').val() <= 90 && newData.child('longitude').isNumber() && newData.child('longitude').val() >= -180 && newData.child('longitude').val() <= 180

$rideId..write: auth != null && (auth.uid == newData.child('driverId').val() || auth.uid == newData.child('clientId').val() || !data.exists() || auth.uid == data.child('driverId').val() || auth.uid == data.child('clientId').val())
$rideId..validate: newData.hasChildren(['rideId','requestId','driverId','clientId','driverLocation','clientLocation','destination','status','originAddress','destinationAddress','originLatitude','originLongitude','destinationLatitude','destinationLongitude','createdAt','updatedAt']) && newData.child('rideId').val() == $rideId && newData.child('driverId').isString() && newData.child('clientId').isString() && newData.child('status').isString() && newData.child('createdAt').isNumber() && newData.child('updatedAt').isNumber() && newData.child('originLatitude').isNumber() && newData.child('originLongitude').isNumber() && newData.child('destinationLatitude').isNumber() && newData.child('destinationLongitude').isNumber()
